study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Martin et al., Drug and Alcohol Dependence Reports, 2025
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Sex differences in normative modeling of cortical thickness in cannabis use disorder

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Normative values for 1344 FreeSurfer-segmented brain regions were derived from k-fold cross-validated regression models using the NOMIS software. NOMIS typically selects the best-fitting polynomial model (linear, quadratic, or cubic) for each ROI.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: The normative values for 1344 FreeSurfer-segmented brain regions were derived from k-fold cross-validated regression models, using which participant-level normative z-scores can be generated via a freely available Python-based script (https://github.com/medicslab/NOMIS).
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Martin2025.pdf.md: Section 2.3 / MRI acquisition and normative modeling

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: The study focused on total and regional cortical thickness (CT). It also examined whole brain volume (GBV), total cerebral white matter volume (WMV), and total subcortical gray matter volume, as well as regional volumes for the hippocampus (SubV) and cerebellum (CerLV).
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: ...sex differences in z-scores of gross segmentations (i.e. whole brain [brainsegvol], total cerebral white matter [cerebralwhitemattervol], total subcortical gray matter [subcortgrayvol], and total cortical thickness [cortexvol]) were first assessed... Hippocampal and cerebellar gray matter z-scores were additionally compared...

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.answer: Age-related:Age; Demographics:Sex; Global brain measures:ICV/TIV; Image/Data quality:Image quality
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: The normative modeling using NOMIS accounted for age, sex, intracranial volume (ICV), and image quality.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: ...accounting for age, sex, intracranial volume, and image quality (Potvin et al., 2022, 2017, 2016).
